evidence: Smallest-submission analysis. The agent starts from an empty /app (environment/Dockerfile: only .gitkeep committed) and must build a greenfield Express+SQLite matter chat; the golden is ~1,300 lines of server/client code (server.js 528, public/app.js 654). The brief and notes require auth, per-person matter scoping, ethical walls enforced on every route including live wall addition, threaded replies 3+ deep, edits with version history and stale-edit refusal, safe formatting, message links with previews, mentions with @-suggestions, per-user unread lines synced across tabs, idempotent sending, ~10 s live updates, disappearing-message timers against a fixed clock, partner-only legal holds, literal search and a transcript page, all persisted across restarts. Stubs are excluded mechanically: score.py zeroes reward unless both gates pass and functional > 0.05 (scoring.toml floors, template-identical). gates/constraints requires a real post that survives reload AND is read back in a separate browser context as another user, so a static page, localStorage mock or single-browser fake fails; gates/render requires a real signed-in Kittle & Rowe surface with nothing private pre-sign-in and wrong passwords refused. The functional floor (>2.2 of 44 weight) cannot be met by a single CRUD screen: the only single criteria above it are signin_and_client_scope (3.0, whose positive controls require working mentions list, search, transcript and server-side refusal of signed-out and cross-client replays), sent_once_in_order (2.5, idempotent replay plus consistent order across thread/search/transcript), and the 4.0 legal-behaviour criteria (walls, retention, timers, search+transcript, persistence of edits/holds/walls/unread); the 1.5/2.0 criteria alone sit below the floor. Weak-app probes: (a) a static mock or client-only chat fails the constraints gate -> 0; (b) a basic server-backed chat with sign-in and posting but no server-side scoping/mentions/search/transcript passes gates yet fails every functional criterion -> floor fails -> 0. Conforming alternative: criteria are browser-observable and avoid prescribing routes (constraints prompt: 'Do not prescribe endpoint names'), so a different but conforming architecture is not penalised on this row. Residual (calibration, not a row-7 defect): an app clearing exactly one functional criterion with strong polish/visual could reach roughly 0.6*0.068 + 0.2*0.83 + 0.2*1.0 ~= 0.41 by my arithmetic, but such an app already embodies substantial real build work. Risk=true because raw-evidence-index.json itself states that reward discrimination/ranking runs, a full configured grading run and Oracle/model scores on these bytes are absent; this row's stub exclusion is established by source analysis and the scripted golden only, not by a measured weak-app reward.
